from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyRevenueGrowth(BaseModel):
    """Financial report data for one company, capturing the growth rate needed for classification."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/证券 code if provided")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    current_period_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Current period operating revenue amount")
    previous_period_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Previous period operating revenue amount")
    revenue_growth_rate: float | None = Field(description="Revenue year-over-year growth rate percentage")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the growth rate or revenue figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_revenue_growth_data: list[CompanyRevenueGrowth]
